document: Huya LoL Hex helper: static protocol evidence and independent reconstruction boundary
purpose: A functional behavior specification for an original implementation. This file contains no extracted vendor source, assets, credentials or authentication material.

provenance.line_number_convention: ASAR line references refer to the formatted local analysis copy whose original and formatted SHA256 values are recorded in source-extraction-manifest.json. Lua line references refer to ZIP entries.

verified_operations: REA CLI dependency installation with lifecycle scripts disabled, local build and static parser execution
Official archive downloaded; MD5 matches anonymous public updater metadata; SHA256 recorded
Inert ASAR/JavaScript, PE metadata, managed CIL and Lua text inspection
not_performed: Execution of any Huya executable, native addon, JavaScript bundle or Lua target
Live League of Legends or Windows integration test
Remote AI authentication, AI requests, screenshot/video transmission or embedded-key use
Live evaluation of recognition accuracy, latency or recommendation quality
evidence_status.static_analysis_coverage: Selected ASAR sources only: 8 JavaScript files parsed, 3153 inventoried files outside selected scope. Application and semantic coverage are partial; semantic graph limits were reached. Native-addon static discovery did not resolve dynamic loading, so zero discovered bindings does not mean none exist.
evidence_status.remote_ai: The original client references a Huya remote inference service. Its model and recommendation computation were not recovered from the inspected UI/client sources. The independent prototype has no connection to that service; service availability was not tested.
evidence_status.runtime_equivalence: Not established. File download and REA execution are verified operations, not runtime evidence for the original helper.

architecture.observed: Windows process/command-line bridge obtains local League client connection information. LCU gameflow and champion-selection responses supply phase, queue and hero context. Hex queue IDs present in this build: 2400, 2410, 3270.
LoL service invokes native StartVideoCapture with Hex mode 0. A successful OnVideoPushResult callback supplies a stream name; stale starts are guarded by a sequence identity.

AI task start receives stream name, current hero, mode key hex_aram, mode name, sequence and signaling context. The client listens for category-filtered remote inference notices containing a JSON data string.
The same remote JSON string is sent to an Electron overlay, the three Hex windows, equipment-config processing and native AIServerNotifyMsg.

Electron/React and native-hosted Lua provide separate presentation paths. Both consume supplied ratings rather than recomputing them. Which path is visible in a particular running configuration requires Windows testing.

fields.lUid: numeric identity supplied by upstream; not needed in independent local replay
fields.cCategoryId: 0 for Hex; 2 is separate TFT category

remote_result_notice.behavior: Notices from a different category are ignored. The client forwards sAIData downstream; it does not derive ratings in these handlers.

fields.isOversea: optional boolean or numeric 1; Lua switches English when true or 1, otherwise Chinese
fields.vHexs: ordered array of choice display entries
fields.vHexs[].sTier: optional rating string; supplied by upstream
fields.vHexs[].fPickRate: numeric fraction used as pick rate; not a win rate or confidence score
fields.vHexs[].mExtra_info.position: string [x, y, width, height]; recognition box in video pixels, top-left origin

decoded_hex_data.limits: These are observed consumed fields, not an exhaustive server schema. Other flows consume hero/equipment fields. No evidence here establishes the server ranking algorithm.

payload.hexs: array containing corresponding vHexs entry, or empty

electron_hex_windows.selection: Main process routes only the first three entries. Renderer accepts matching window index; chooses first entry with nonempty tier, otherwise first entry. It does not compare tier strengths.
electron_hex_windows.display: S/A/B/C map to rating images; unknown or missing tier uses empty image. Missing tier text indicates unavailable data. With nonempty tier, pickRate *100 is formatted to exactly two decimal places.
electron_hex_windows.geometry: Scale recognition X/width by gameW/videoW and Y/height by gameH/videoH. Horizontally center window on recognition box; put window below its lower edge with height-scaled offset. Missing valid position/video size yields empty bounds.

native_lua_bridge.transport: JSON envelope via host notifyEvent; actual implementation reads cmd, despite stale documentation examples using protocol.

clear.behavior: Clears Hex, equipment and gold views/caches immediately

native_lua_bridge.excluded_payloads: If decoded data has page_type, game_state or lineup_recommend, Hex handler skips it as TFT-shaped data.
native_lua_bridge.display: Preserves input order; iterates all sequential entries with no explicit three-item cap. Does not rank, pick the best tier, automate selection or reroll. Existing rating resources: S/A/B/C/empty. Unknown nonempty tier has no resource-existence fallback.
native_lua_bridge.pick_rate: Fraction *100, up to four decimal places with trailing zeros removed; no clamping. Missing value defaults to zero. Missing tier instead displays unavailable-data text.
native_lua_bridge.geometry: Independent horizontal/vertical video-to-canvas scales; horizontal box center; top-left video origin converted to renderer bottom-left origin; height-adaptive below-card layout. Absent video_hw defaults to [1080, 1920].
native_lua_bridge.lifetime: Three consecutive absent/invalid data updates or absent vHexs clear retained views. Explicit vHexs=[] clears on the next changed payload. Equal serialized decoded data does not redraw unless forced. Resize redraws cache. No Lua wall-time expiry or mode polling.

gold_difference.visibility_command: native2lua_setGoldDiffVisible with visible strictly true to show
gold_difference.behavior: Data and visibility are separate. Lua does not listen for Tab itself. Difference appears on self-team panel; color is team-based, not sign-based. abs(diffValue)<1 or empty/0 diff hides it. Lua does not recompute values; protocol comments describe purchased equipment value.

generic_lua_electron_request.behavior: One-shot matching callback by requestId. No timeout/retry found.
generic_lua_electron_request.scope_warning: Only production actions found were tft.copyLineupCode and tft.showAssistPanel. These do not establish a Hex selection/control API.

lifecycle_observations.warning: 5000ms is a minimum start-attempt spacing constant, not evidence of one screenshot every five seconds or AI inference frequency.
lifecycle_observations.stale_callbacks: Stream start identity and deduplication guards prevent stale/duplicate start callbacks from establishing a current session.
lifecycle_observations.stop: Native capture stop, remote task stop and view clear paths exist; phase transitions, reconnect and delayed termination logic are more complex than a single immediate end-of-game stop.

other_observed_side_effects.observation: Main process converts upstream hero/equipment names to IDs and writes owned-prefix item-set JSON files into LoL Config/Global/Recommended. It deduplicates by equipment-name digest, removes previous owned-prefix files and cleans up after game exit. The Lua equipment panel normal data call is commented out; file writing and Lua panel are separate features.
LCU acceptance methods are packaged. Their presence is not proof they ran during this analysis or are enabled by default. The independent prototype does not implement game actions.

independent_implementation.current_deliverable: Original local manual-reference prototype; synthetic default data/private local imports; no automatic recognition claim.
recommended_module_boundary: Independent recognizer returning card identity and box
Independent data/ranking provider returning tier, pick-rate source and explanation
normalization_rules: Keep pick rate separate from win rate and recognition confidence
Use numeric bounding-box and video-size objects internally, not vendor-shaped coordinate strings
Reject NaN/Infinity and zero/negative video dimensions; bound input text/array lengths
Preserve display order independently of recommendation ranking
Track source version, timestamp and confidence; expose unknown/stale data clearly
Add response timeouts and session IDs; clear on explicit empty result, stop, mode switch or expiry
future_validation_gates: Synthetic replay tests for 0/1/3/many cards, missing tier, malformed JSON, empty arrays, repeated payloads, stale callbacks, mismatched mode and resize
Windows read-only integration with actual game phase/window/DPI/resolution/fullscreen variations, only after permission for applicable software and capture
Own recognition evaluation on user-approved screenshots/video; measure accuracy and latency separately
Any network image transmission needs a separately selected service and explicit privacy/data authorization; no vendor embedded keys or undocumented credential reuse
not_recovered: Remote model weights or inference implementation
Server recommendation ranking formula or proprietary dataset
Windows overlay compatibility, anti-cheat compatibility or verified game-safety guarantee
independent_implementation.license_boundary: REA repository MIT license applies to REA. Package metadata license fields do not establish redistribution rights to every Huya source, asset, dataset or dependency. Ship original implementation and authorized/synthetic data only.
